This Appeal, Coming On For Hearing, This Day, The
Court Delivered The Following:
 Judgment

This is an appeal filed by the claimant aggrieved by the dismissal of the claim petition in MVC.No.3171/2011 dated 08.05.2015 on the file of the VIII Addl. Small Causes Judge & XXXIII ACMM, MACT- Bangalore.

entities.text: VIII Addl. Small Causes Judge & XXXIII ACMM, MACT- Bangalore
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 2. The case of the claimant is that he was an inmate of the autorickshaw proceeding from Channapatna towards Agraharavagerahali, near Yarabnagar, Channapatna Taluk at that time, a car driven by its driver in a rash and negligent manner hit the autorickshaw and the passengers of autorickshaw sustained injuries.
First they were shifted to NC: 2023:KHC:33352 Government Hospital, Channapatna and from there they were shifted to other Hospitals.

In respect of the said incident, altogether four petitions were filed, three petitions are filed by the inmates of the autorickshaw and fourth petition is filed by the owner of the vehicle seeking compensation.
The present appeal is filed against the award passed in MVC.No.3171/2011.

The court below basing on the Ex.R-25, held that the claimant- Appellant herein is the driver of the offending vehicle and because of his negligence, the accident had happened and accordingly dismissed the claim petition.
As far as other three petitions are concerned, the compensation was awarded.
Learned Counsel for the Appellant submits that the finding of the court below is contrary to the police evidence and other evidence placed on record.
It is submitted that in Crime No.42/2011, it is stated that the Autodriver-Nagendra is injured & suffered abrasions.

Further it is submitted that basing on Ex.R-25 Mr. Pradeep M.K vs Bharti Axa General Insurance on 14 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/118241592/
2 i.e., FIR, the Appellant before this court is the driver of the Autorickshaw.

entities.text: Pradeep M.K vs Bharti Axa General Insurance
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The court below held that the accident had happened because of the rash and negligent driving of the driver of the Autorickshaw and the said claim petition was dismissed.
Learned Counsel for the Appellant further submits that all the evidence shows that appellant is the inmate of the Car.
By only relying on Ex.R-25, the court below has given such a finding.
It is submitted that he is not the driver but inmate of the Car.

Learned Counsel for the insurance company submits that court below basing on the evidence had rightly held that as the claimant-Appellant herein is driver of the vehicle, he is not entitled for any compensation, as the accident had happened because of his negligence and the court below had dismissed the claim petition.

In this case, there is contradictory evidence on record where in one crime, the driver of vehicle is mentioned as Nagendra and in the other case -the Appellant before this court is shown as driver of the Vehicle.
The court below had mainly relied on Ex.R-25 and whereas other evidence is concerned, it was not gone in detail by the Tribunal.
4. In view of the same, the judgment passed by the Tribunal is set aside and the matter is remitted back to the court below.
The court below shall consider the case afresh on who is the driver of the Autorickshaw at the time of incident by considering the entire evidence on record.

If the court comes to the finding that vehicle is driven by Nagendra, then whether NC: 2023:KHC:33352 Nagendra is having a valid driving license has to be examine, whereas in the other cases, as the driver of the vehicle was not having the license, the Tribunal had held that the owner alone is liable,
this aspect also has to be gone into by the court below.
(i) Accordingly, the appeal is remanded back to the Tribunal and the claim petition shall be disposed off in accordance with law within four months from date of receipt of copy of this Judgment.
(ii) Without further notice, both the parties shall be present before the Court below on 11-10- 2023.

SD/-
